description: The repository's letter rating A+/A/B/C/D/F — the health report's grade (the same number gluecron_repo_health and the /health page show; A is 85+) — with the score, the six categories (score, weight, points still available), `to_a`: the ordered list of concrete items that move the repository to A (each with the action, the points available, whether a loop can do it mechanically, and the evidence: file:line for a security finding, counts otherwise), then the delivery blockers beside it (red default branch, conflicting PRs, PRs red for a week, open ai:repair issues, issues older than 30 days — shown under `delivery`, never merged into the letter), and the last 30 recorded days. Owner mandate 2026-11-04: every repository should be A. Read-only.
